::: {#hero-heading}
I am a statistician at Bayer CropScience, working on applied statistics, data science, GLP validation, and practical R/SAS workflows. I enjoy data interpretation, multidisciplinary problem-solving, and collaboration, especially when complex questions become clearer through teamwork.


:::

### 

Hi! This is a space where I share my thoughts, learnings, and ideas related to statistics, ecotoxicology, and more, anything that does not belong to a structured, topic-specific repository. Think of it as a dump or a jungle of information - while it may seem chaotic and unorganized, there could be hidden gems of insight and knowledge within. :) The primary goal of this site is to help myself understand and learn more effectively while keeping a log of my thought process. Although the content may not be perfectly organized, I hope part of it can serve as a valuable resource for others who have similar questions and interests in these fields. Here, you will find a collection of reflections, analyses, and discussions that I hope will inspire and assist fellow professionals and learners.

I do not publish on a strict schedule. Sometimes I jot down a thought and publish a placeholder that I never come back to, but when an idea matures, I share it here.
